findings.title: Content-Security-Policy
findings.reason: script-src allows 'unsafe-inline' without a nonce or hash, so injected inline scripts can run
findings.fix_hint: enforce a CSP whose script-src allows no inline or wildcard scripts

platform_fixes.how: Rules > Transform Rules > Modify Response Header > Set static: Content-Security-Policy
platform_fixes.note: A static Transform Rule cannot add a per-request nonce; set the CSP in the app, use hashes, or a Worker

platform_fixes.how: add_header Content-Security-Policy "..." always; nonces: set them in the app, or sub_filter with $request_id

findings.title: Technology disclosure

evidence.detail: server: nginx/1.24.0; x-powered-by: PHP/8.2.1; meta generator: WordPress 6.5.2

findings.reason: server, x-powered-by +1 tell attackers which software and version runs here
findings.fix_hint: remove X-Powered-By, version numbers and internal host names from headers and meta generator

platform_fixes.how: server_tokens off; PHP: fastcgi_hide_header X-Powered-By; proxy: proxy_hide_header X-Powered-By;
php.ini expose_php = Off, and hide the server version on the web server
platform_fixes.note: meta generator: remove_action('wp_head', 'wp_generator') in the theme's functions.php

findings.title: HTTPS enforcement
findings.reason: http:// moves to https:// with a temporary redirect (302), which browsers do not remember
findings.fix_hint: redirect every http:// request to https:// with 301 or 308

platform_fixes.how: SSL/TLS > Edge Certificates > Always Use HTTPS: On
server { listen 80; server_name example.com; return 301 https://$host$request_uri; }

findings.review_question: Is the temporary redirect intentional? If not, make it 301 or 308.

findings.title: Cookie security
findings.reason: HttpOnly missing on theme, so page scripts can read it
findings.fix_hint: mark cookies Secure, HttpOnly (unless scripts need them) and SameSite=Lax
findings.example_fix: Set-Cookie: session=<value>; Path=/; Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax

platform_fixes.how: Core login cookies are HttpOnly; set FORCE_SSL_ADMIN true in wp-config.php and check plugin cookies

findings.review_question: Does page JavaScript need to read these cookies? If not, add HttpOnly.

findings.title: Permissions-Policy
findings.reason: camera=* lets every embedded site use it
findings.fix_hint: send a valid Permissions-Policy that turns off features the site does not use

platform_fixes.how: Rules > Transform Rules > Modify Response Header > Set static: Permissions-Policy

findings.review_question: Do embedded sites need these features? If not, use =() or =(self).

findings.title: Strict-Transport-Security
findings.advice: add includeSubDomains once every subdomain serves HTTPS, so subdomains are protected too
